props.name: activationMode
props.description:
Whether arrow-key focus movement activates the step immediately (`automatic`) or only moves
focus until `Enter` or `Space` confirms it (`manual`).

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially active step value for uncontrolled usage. The first enabled step is active when omitted.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the entire stepper is disabled: no step can be activated by click or keyboard.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM `id` of the stepper root element; the trigger and panel ids derive from it. Generated when omitted.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of steps to display, in order.
examples:
import { Stepper } from 'moraine'

<Stepper
  navigation="free"
  items={[
    { value: 'cart', label: 'Cart', description: '2 items' },
    { value: 'shipping', label: 'Shipping', icon: 'icon-truck' },
    { value: 'payment', label: 'Payment', disabled: true },
  ]}
/>

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether arrow-key navigation wraps from the last step to the first and back. Disabled steps are skipped.

props.name: navigation
props.description:
How users move between steps. `none` keeps only the active step enabled, `linear` also allows
completed steps and the next step, and `free` allows every enabled step.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the step's `value` when the user activates a different step by click or keyboard.
It does not fire for programmatic `value` changes, for the already-active step, or while the
stepper is `disabled`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction in which steps are laid out. It also decides which arrow keys move between steps.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled active step value. When `undefined`, or when it matches no enabled step, the first enabled step is active.
Steps before the active one are marked completed.

item.description: An individual step in the stepper.

props.name: class
props.description:
Extra class applied to this step's item element. It is merged after the `item` slot classes,
including `classes.item`, so its utilities win on conflict.

props.name: content
props.description:
Content to display in the panel below the steps while this step is active. Accepts static JSX
or a component receiving `{ value, index }`. A step without `content` renders no panel.
examples:
import { Stepper } from 'moraine' Choose a plan.

}, { value: 'pay', label: 'Pay', content: (props) =>

Step {props.index + 1}: {props.value}

}, ]} />

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary description of the step, shown with the label and used as the trigger's accessible description.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the step is disabled.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Icon to display in the step indicator. When omitted, the indicator shows the one-based step
number.

props.name: label
props.description: Label of the step. It names the step trigger for assistive technology.

props.name: value
props.description:
Unique value identifying the step in `value` and `onValueChange`. A step that repeats an
earlier step's value is disabled.
